meta.name: store-listing-assets
meta.description: Use when writing store copy to character limits (name, subtitle, descriptions, keywords) or preparing listing images (icon, feature graphic, screenshots, preview video).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成商店上架文案和图片素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用商店发布应用并准备素材。
copy.tagline_en: Generate store listing copy and image assets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare app store listing copy and images.

howto.what: 帮助用户编写符合字符限制的应用商店文案（名称、副标题、描述、关键词），并生成或调整图标、截图、功能图等图像素材，满足各平台尺寸和格式要求。
howto.when: 当用户需要编写或调整应用商店文案（名称、副标题、描述、关键词）或准备上架图片（图标、功能图、截图）时触发。

say.text: 帮我在Google Play上架一个免费记账应用，写短描述和完整描述。
say.note: 生成文案并标注字符数。

say.text: 我需要一套iPhone 6.5寸截图，展示主界面、设置和统计页面。
say.note: 给出尺寸建议和内容指南。

say.text: 这是我写的应用描述，检查是否超过4000字符。
say.note: 返回字数统计及合规性。

howto.what_en: Helps write store copy (name, subtitle, description, keywords) to character limits and produce or resize visual assets (icon, feature graphic, screenshots) to exact platform specs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to write or adjust app store listing copy (name, subtitle, description, keywords) or prepare listing images (icon, feature graphic, screenshots).

say_en.text: Write a short description and full description for my free expense tracker app on Google Play.
I need iPhone 6.5" screenshots showing the home, settings, and stats screens.
Check if this app description exceeds 4000 characters.
